content.text:
I have completed my review. I ran the mobile test suite (43 pass), `tsc --noEmit` (clean), and the version-sync `--check` gate (passes), and validated gitignore coverage for generated artifacts and the PNG negation rules. Most of the change is solid, well-tested scaffolding. I found one substantive functional bug.

## Summary of working

- **Config/tooling changes** (`.gitignore`, `README.md`, `devenv.nix`, `justfile`, `package.json`, `scripts/sync-version.ts`, `bunfig.toml`, `devenv.yaml`): consistent and correct. The new `mobile` workspace, `just mobile-*` recipes, version-sync targets (`mobile/package.json` + `mobile/app.json`), and Expo/Android ignore rules all check out. Generated dirs (`.expo/`, `dist/`, `android/`) are correctly ignored while `mobile/assets/**/*.png` are re-included.
- **Mobile app** (`mobile/`): typechecks and tests pass. Cross-package import of `web/src/keating/core` is safe (that module has no imports and Metro's `serverRoot` is the monorepo root). All native module imports are declared dependencies. React version skew (`19.2.3` vs root `^19.2.7`) is resolved cleanly by Bun's isolated store and satisfies react-native's `^19.2.3` peer.

## Finding

The provider history-truncation window can begin on an assistant turn, which Anthropic (and, more loosely, Gemini) reject because their `messages`/`contents` arrays must start with a user turn.
